name: Monstr Alishera
source:
Citizens are asked to stay calm, don't believe gossips and be careful. In a case you have noticed a suspected person you must report about it in the nearest police station... 

[From [url=https://jd03.itch.io/monster-of-alisher]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
请广大市民保持冷静，不信谣言，提高警惕。如果你发现可疑人员，你必须向最近的警察局报告…… 

[来自[url=https://jd03.itch.io/monster-of-alisher]itch.io[/url]]
